title: Guidelines for Use of Diplomatic Bags and Past Cases of Misuse
what_it_is: Guidelines for Use of Diplomatic Bags and Past Cases of Misuse

sections.label: Diplomatic bag use and review
sections.summary: Limited personal items are allowed for staff overseas duties, with no questionable use in five years except a case before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Limited quantities of personal items are allowed to enable our staff to fulfil their overseas duties effectively.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: So, for example, during the COVID-19 pandemic, some limited medical supplies were also sent to our staff.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: There have been no instances of questionable use of the diplomatic bag in the past five years, except for a case that is presently before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We have a system and guidelines in place for the proper use of the diplomatic bag and we will review our processes periodically.

sections.label: Diplomatic bag item declarations
sections.summary: Staff must declare items in the diplomatic bag, which must not contravene import or export restrictions and are subject to x-ray surveillance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The staff have to declare the items which are going in the diplomatic bag.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The items must not contravene any import or export restrictions imposed, either by Singapore or by the receiving state.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: And like all other baggage that goes on board planes, they are also subject to x-ray surveillance and, of course, any other checks that are legally permissible under diplomatic practice.
